description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for rebase behavior in Git, specifically focusing on conflict detection, resolution failures, and permission issues during rebasing.

methods.name: create_conflict
methods.description: Sets up a conflicting rebase situation by creating conflicting commits and attempting a rebase.

methods.name: check_resolve_fails
methods.description: Attempts to continue a rebase after a conflict has been artificially resolved, expecting failure.
